meta.title: Enable AVX‑512 xof_many on Windows
meta.body_summary: Port blake3_xof_many_avx512 to Windows assembly (GNU .S and MSVC .asm), expose in C headers and Rust FFI, and enable dispatch on Windows.

perf_labels.notes: Codex-generated AVX-512 Windows xof_many port crashed with STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION in cargo test; maintainer closed immediately.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 109 changed lines across 7 files, this is a small change by absolute volume, consistent with a targeted performance enablement. The PR was closed before review due to a runtime crash, a non-merge outcome that aligns with the scale.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR received no formal review; the author ran cargo test on Windows and reported a STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION crash during testing, indicating incorrect memory access in the assembly code.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable AVX-512 xof_many on Windows for improved XOF streaming hash performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author self-tested crash and closed PR; no external rejection signals.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Porting AVX-512 assembly to Windows requires OS-specific calling conventions and correct register handling; Codex produced code that compiled but crashed at runtime, illustrating a boundary in low-level platform-specific assembly generation.

detection_detail.manual_test: Maintainer ran cargo test on Windows, which failed with STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION, indicating a memory access error in the newly added assembly code.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Only a failing test run provided; no successful test or benchmark data to validate the performance claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed immediately upon failure without attempt to fix; no follow-up.

core_change_summary.description: Add blake3_xof_many_avx512 function in both GNU .S and MSVC .asm Windows assembly files, remove OS guards in C headers and Rust FFI to expose the function under Windows, and update dispatch/platform code to call it.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Non-assembly changes are minimal, mostly removing conditional compilation to enable xof_many on Windows.
change_trajectory: Single commit introduces Windows xof_many implementations and updates bindings/dispatch; no subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Author noted PR was autogenerated by Codex for fun and untested.
Maintainer tested with cargo test on Windows, which hit STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION (0xc0000005) during test run, indicating memory access error.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by oconnor663 with label 'codex' and autogenerated notice.
Author ran cargo test, observed STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION crash, and closed PR immediately.
